name: music-nerd-recovery
description: A blockchain-led recovery archive of the music NFT era

scripts.check: node --check server.mjs && node --check src/archive.js && node --check src/recovery-model.mjs && node --check src/recovery-owner.mjs && node --check src/recovery-holders.mjs && node --check src/collectors-ui.mjs && node --check src/collector-profiles.mjs && node --check src/personal-playlists.mjs && node --check src/catalog-bundle.mjs && node --check src/legacy-collectors.mjs && node --check src/recovery-coverage.mjs
scripts.ci: npm run check && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run test:browser
scripts.test:browser: node scripts/verify-archive.mjs && node scripts/verify-personal-playlists.mjs && node scripts/verify-collectors.mjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check archive.html src/archive.js src/archive.css src/recovery-*.mjs src/personal-playlists.mjs src/collectors-ui.mjs src/collector-profiles.mjs server.mjs scripts/verify-*.mjs tests/recovery.test.mjs package.json src/catalog-bundle.mjs src/legacy-collectors.mjs tests/catalog-bundle.test.mjs tests/legacy-collectors.test.mjs tests/coverage.test.mjs
